title: RISPAH
summary: Raleigh names RISPAH in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). RISPAH, who bare two sonnes vnto SAVL, which the King deliuered to the Gibeonites. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XVII, §. VII, sig. 298a
